Additive annual water and design-generation totals divided by 12 as requested; this creates uniform monthly proxies, not observed seasonality. NASA POWER monthly precipitation is a mean daily rate and was multiplied by 30; FAO-56 ET0 was calculated as a daily rate and multiplied by 30. Annual crop area is a stock and is repeated within 2021 rather than divided by 12. Crop coefficients/stages use FAO-56 planning values with provisional local calendars; validate before inference. E3-E9 are retained but left blank where no boundary-consistent public monthly series was found; E6/E7 allocations are model decisions and need not be independently observed. L_res is reservoir water loss and L_base is electricity base load; the two L symbols have different meanings and separate columns.
